name: Fava bean

schedule.notes: Plant as early as soil can be worked. Heat above 75 F shuts down pod set.
Mild-winter (zone 7+) fall planting overwinters for spring harvest.
Pods full and glossy. Or pick small for whole-pod eating.

harvest.cues: Pods 4 to 6 in, plump, glossy. Pick from the bottom up.
harvest.storageNotes: Shell fresh, blanch and freeze. Dried beans store years.

varieties.name: Broad Windsor
varieties.notes: Large flat beans. The classic English variety.

varieties.name: Aquadulce
varieties.notes: Most cold-tolerant. Best for fall sowing in zones 6+.

notes: WARNING: favism (a genetic G6PD deficiency) can cause severe reactions in some people — know your sensitivity. Excellent green manure: dig under flowering plants to feed the soil with nitrogen.
